name: Live Demo Stream
description: Streams players' views live from an instance to ql-stats-hub through a central relay, over a TLS tunnel on each host. Has no menu entries of its own: the stream, its delay, the host tunnel and the relay are set in the Stats Hub entries of the Telemetry Relay addon (1.9.0 or newer), next to telemetry. Needs a game server with the sv_demoStream cvars.
